name: look-target
title: Look at a target
description: Aim the head camera at a target (turning the base if it is outside the head yaw range) and record every annotated object in view as observed.
use_when: A known target must be brought into the head camera view.

not_to_be_confused_with.inspect: inspect reports a receptacle's contents; look only aims the camera.
not_to_be_confused_with.search: search visits several places to find an unseen object.

seen.description: Objects in the head camera frustum with clear line of sight.

postconditions.name: in_view
postconditions.meaning: Target point inside the head camera frustum, within 5 m, line of sight not blocked by furniture boxes.
postconditions.checked: after the policy chain on live GT state; the action is reported only if true

postconditions.name: observed
postconditions.meaning: The robot saw the target in its head camera during this episode (set by look, search, inspect, explore).
postconditions.checked: after the policy chain on live GT state; the action is reported only if true

verifier.how: after the policy chain, every listed predicate is evaluated on ground-truth simulator state (object poses, joint values, finger gaps, head-camera geometry, thermal state, event log); the node succeeds only if all hold for the selected path

checks.name: in_view
checks.meaning: Target point inside the head camera frustum, within 5 m, line of sight not blocked by furniture boxes.
checks.checked: after the policy chain on live GT state; the action is reported only if true

checks.name: observed
checks.meaning: The robot saw the target in its head camera during this episode (set by look, search, inspect, explore).
checks.checked: after the policy chain on live GT state; the action is reported only if true

previous.when: the destination must be observed first
the robot looks back at a target

next.when: the observed target will be manipulated

fallback.when: the line of sight is blocked

alternative.when: the target is a receptacle whose contents matter
a gaze is enough to indicate the target

failure.on_failure: stop; return every measured predicate, the completed policy steps and the fallback skills whose repaired predicate failed; the planner chooses what to do. Inside a multi-object node a nested call that fails a precondition with a matching repair fallback runs that repair once and retries.
